import collections,csv,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/recovery')
from inspect_release import Image
from canonicalize_helpers import sha
from capstone import Cs,CS_ARCH_X86,CS_MODE_32,CS_GRP_JUMP
from capstone.x86_const import X86_OP_IMM
image=Image(Path('.recovery/2022-ManalinkEh.dll').read_bytes());dbg=Image(Path('G:/Manalink/ManalinkEh_10_22_Hotfix.dbg').read_bytes())
names=collections.defaultdict(set)
for n,o,s,k,t in dbg.symbols:
 if n in ['_get_color','_get_color_by_internal_id','_get_sleighted_color_test']:
  if s==-1:names[n].add(o)
  elif s>0:names[n].add(0x2000000+dbg.pe.sections[s-1].VirtualAddress+o)
assert len(names)==3 and all(len(v)==1 for v in names.values())
targets={next(iter(v)):n for n,v in names.items()};right=next(iter(names['_get_sleighted_color_test']))
meta=list(csv.DictReader(Path('.recovery/reccmp/current-refresh-c721.metadata.csv').open()));md=Cs(CS_ARCH_X86,CS_MODE_32);md.detail=True;rows=[]
for name,count in [('card_phyrexian_boon',2),('card_serras_boon',2),('card_chandra_ablaze',2)]:
 r=next(r for r in meta if r['name']==name);base=int(r['address'],0);size=int(r['size']);raw=image.pe.get_data(base-0x2000000,size)
 code=list(md.disasm(raw,base));assert sum(i.size for i in code)==size
 call_indices=[j for j,i in enumerate(code) if i.mnemonic=='call'];pairs=[]
 for first,second in zip(call_indices,call_indices[1:]):
  a,b=code[first],code[second]
  if (a.operands[0].type!=X86_OP_IMM or b.operands[0].type!=X86_OP_IMM or b.operands[0].imm!=right
      or targets.get(a.operands[0].imm) not in ['_get_color','_get_color_by_internal_id']):continue
  assert not any(i.group(CS_GRP_JUMP) or i.mnemonic=='ret' for i in code[first+1:second])
  incoming=[hex(i.address) for i in code if i.group(CS_GRP_JUMP) and i.operands[0].type==X86_OP_IMM and a.address<i.operands[0].imm<=b.address and not a.address<i.address<=b.address]
  assert not incoming,(name,incoming)
  data=raw[a.address-base:b.address-base+b.size]
  pairs.append(dict(first_callee=targets[a.operands[0].imm],first_call=hex(a.address),second_call=hex(b.address),bytes_hex=data.hex(),sha256=sha(data),instructions=[dict(address=hex(i.address),instruction=i.mnemonic+' '+i.op_str) for i in code[first:second+1]],scope='Contiguous call-to-call sequence without intervening call, jump, return or outside direct branch into the interval; selected sites only, not whole-function proof.'))
 assert len(pairs)==count,(name,len(pairs),count)
 rows.append(dict(name=name,address=r['address'],pairs=pairs))
out=dict(inputs={p:sha(Path(p).read_bytes()) for p in ['.recovery/2022-ManalinkEh.dll','G:/Manalink/ManalinkEh_10_22_Hotfix.dbg']},script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),native_callee_addresses={n:hex(next(iter(v))) for n,v in names.items()},functions=rows,scope='Six native color-then-sleight physical sites for four source query pairs: aura AI/stat paths are duplicated. Chandra resolution parent loads are between 0x25df62a and 0x25df652, following get_color; priority grave-ID reads remain fresh around callbacks. Named int-return caller/callee and ordinary-memory assumptions apply, no callee semantics, full CFG or gameplay claim.')
Path('.recovery/reccmp/native-color-sites-c724.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Collected six native color-before-sleight sites across three callers.')
